Uttar Pradesh Launches Enrolment Festival for School Chalo Abhiyan

The Indian state of Uttar Pradesh has launched the second phase of its 'School Chalo Abhiyan' initiative, which aims to boost school enrollment. The program is being implemented across 1.32 lakh schools in the state, with an emphasis on celebrating enrolment festivals to encourage more students to join schools.
